envelope.description: Close out: exclusions, registration, inventory, docs and the full sweep

body.title: Close out: exclusions, registration, inventory, docs and the full sweep
body.summary: Mark for-each-repo, hook, filter-branch, merge-octopus, merge-ours, merge-recursive, merge-recursive-ours, merge-recursive-theirs, merge-resolve, merge-subtree, subtree, request-pull and quiltimport excluded with the reasons the user gave (no program needs request-pull or quiltimport). Register the new tools in definitions.ts as withFailureNet(tool), update the inventory and registration tests, turn on the rule in git-coverage.test.ts that fails for any row still assigned, write the s8 outcome in docs/plans/tool-registry.md, then run the full sweep once.
acceptanceChecks: No coverage row is assigned; every excluded row has a reason; every command of GIT_2_53_COMMANDS has a row
Each of for-each-repo, hook, filter-branch, the seven merge strategy drivers, subtree, request-pull and quiltimport is an excluded row with a reason, and the rule fails when one is left assigned
The inventory test compares gitToolDefinitions with every tool the git files export
The full sweep matches the known baseline failures and adds none
docs/plans/tool-registry.md records the s8 outcome and the user's decisions

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-coverage.test.ts: no row is assigned, every excluded row has a reason and every command has a row
src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/typed-git-tools.test.ts: gitToolDefinitions matches every tool the git files export and each is registered as withFailureNet(tool)
